title: Sentinelized Shadow Gates and Rollback Strategy for Eval Prompt Sets
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a sentinelized gating system that ties shadow traffic and small A/B cohorts to golden eval prompt sets (scorecards). The goal is to detect quality regressions early for canary and shadowed deployments and enable automatic quarantine/rollback when thresholds are breached. The feature must support weighted prompt sets, per-customer thresholds, hysteresis to avoid flapping, and a human-in-the-loop escalation path.
background: We currently run canaries and shadow traffic but lack a unified, provably-safe mechanism to use eval prompt sets as gating signals. Several incidents in Q4 showed subtle regressions that standard telemetry missed but would be caught by targeted golden prompts (format regressions, hallucination frequency on anchor prompts). This ticket creates the orchestration and API hooks required to attach 'sentinels' to shadow splits and small canary cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Engine can register 3 types of sentinels for a rollout: golden_prompt_score, embedding_similarity, structured-output-assertions
Scorecards support weighted prompts and per-prompt severity mapping
Automatic quarantine triggers when configurable composite score falls below threshold for N-minute window with configurable hysteresis
Rollout API exposes signals: SENTINEL_FAIL_RATE, SENTINEL_COMPOSITE_SCORE, and SENTINEL_CONFIDENCE
UI shows per-sentinel trend and last failing examples with links to matching requests
Canary can be auto-rolled-back by orchestration when auto-rollback policy is enabled and confirmed by 2 independent sentinels
Audit log entry created for every auto-quarantine/rollback with trigger reasons and linked evaluation artifacts
End-to-end tests covering: 1) single-prompt regression, 2) gradual drift, 3) noisy transient failures with hysteresis, and 4) per-customer threshold overrides

risks_and_mitigation: False positives causing unnecessary rollbacks: mitigate with hysteresis, multi-sentinel confirmation, and opt-in auto-rollback flag
Performance overhead on runtime for synchronous checks: keep evaluation on shadow traffic async and sample at configurable rate
Complexity of per-customer thresholds increasing config surface: provide sane defaults and UI helpers to suggest thresholds based on historical variability
Dataset poisoning or overfitting to golden prompts: allow rotation and versioning of golden sets, encourage use of diverse prompts
design_decisions: Async evaluation of sentinels on shadow traffic to avoid adding latency to live requests
Composite score computed as weighted percentile across prompt groups rather than simple average to reduce sensitivity to outliers
Require at least two independent sentinel types to trigger auto-rollback unless opt-in single-sentinel policy is explicitly set
Expose a 'quarantine-only' mode that prevents traffic ramp but does not auto-rollback to give on-call time to assess
testing_plan: Unit tests for sentinel scoring functions and severity mappings
Integration tests for registration, metric aggregation, and policy evaluation
Simulated shadow stream with injected regressions to validate hysteresis and multi-sentinel confirmation
Load test to measure overhead at 10% shadow sampling for a 500 RPS production-like stream
